validation.contextAndScope: Process memory accounting: RSS/PSS, smaps, OOM and reclaim indicators.

validation.causeAndAlternatives: The draft conflated per-process mappings with system-wide accounting and treated candidate counters as diagnoses; shared mappings, kernel/page-cache use, allocator retention and concurrent mappings are alternatives.

validation.contextAndScope: Heaptrack Linux allocator-call tracing and CLI/GUI workflows.

validation.evidence: Compared KDE heaptrack README and tracking wrapper docs; corrected scope, `.gz`/build compression, `--record-only`, attach warning, removed unsupported environment options/compare command, and revised description to match content.

validation.contextAndScope: glibc allocator diagnostics: MALLOC_CHECK_, perturbation, mtrace, mcheck, mallinfo2 and tunables.
validation.signalAndRefutation: The original one-line `MALLOC_CHECK_` framing omitted the glibc 2.34+ debug-library requirement and overstated byte patterns, check modes, and RSS return guarantees.
validation.causeAndAlternatives: glibc version/configuration and `libc_malloc_debug` loading alter availability; debug checks are limited and can change process behavior. mcheck has a before-first-allocation condition.
validation.evidence: Compared GNU libc manual sections for heap checking, mtrace and tunables. Corrected preload examples, mode interpretation, mtrace framing, mcheck timing, pattern caveat and claims about allocator statistics/trim. Description now names version/debug-library conditions.

validation.decision: Remediated; chapter description was manually corrected and is recorded here. Treat debug features as limited diagnostic options, not production safety guarantees.

validation.contextAndScope: Production leak diagnosis: PSS trends, profiler sampling, BCC, drgn, cgroup, PSI and graceful degradation.
validation.signalAndRefutation: Trend slopes and outstanding stacks could be mistaken for leak proof; ru_maxrss as current RSS, PSI semantics, cgroup limits and automatic recovery behavior were overclaimed.
validation.causeAndAlternatives: Signals have different scopes and windows; `ru_maxrss` is a maximum, allocator profiling has overhead, cgroup reclaim/OOM is group-scoped, and a one-minute 50% trigger misses slow leaks.
validation.evidence: Compared kernel PSI and cgroup v2 docs, systemd-oomd docs, profiler docs and allocator interfaces. Qualified trend interpretation, sampling overhead, PSI some/full, cgroup behavior, automatic dump trigger and systemd-oomd behavior; removed unsafe current-RSS/trim sample.
validation.sampleScope: Full article read, including examples. Linux PSI/BCC/drgn/cgroup/JVM/Python tools and allocator-profiler paths were not run on this host.
validation.decision: Remediated: use multiple scoped signals and label automatic dump logic as a narrow trigger, not general leak detection.
validation.smallestSafeChangeAndRollback: Article-body claims/examples only; route/date/draft/order preserved. Rollback boundary is this article file.
validation.verificationAndResidualRisk: Gates, inline-math and verifier pass. Linux collection, production impact, BCC/drgn availability, and every language/runtime integration remain untested.
